message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes in the history of the sport. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he played high school basketball at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he gained national attention and was named the USA Today High School Player of the Year.

He entered the NBA directly from high school, being selected first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in the 2003 draft. LeBron quickly became known for his combination of size, athleticism, passing ability, and basketball IQ. He has won multiple NBA championships (with the Miami Heat in 2012 and 2013, the Cleveland Cavaliers in 2016, and the Los Angeles Lakers in 2020), earned numerous MVP awards, and has been selected to the All‑NBA First Team many times.

Beyond the court, LeBron is also a philanthropist, entrepreneur, and media personality. He founded the LeBron James Family Foundation, which focuses on education initiatives such as the I Promise School in Akron. He has produced films and television shows through his production company, SpringHill Entertainment, and has appeared in movies and commercials. LeBron continues to be a prominent figure in sports, business, and social activism.
